Name: Shopkeeper Leela - Pierre's Competition (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[size=4][b]Ridgeside and Downhill Project Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=2]As of 1.0.4, if you have RSV installed, Leela's house is moved automatically to make room for the RSV stairs, rather than having to enable the patch manually. For this update, please delete the old folder of this mod before extracting the new one, as some of the file structure has been changed. Nothing should break in game, but you might get some smapi error mesages if you skip this step.

As of the 1.0.3 update, if you have RSV and Downhill Project installed at the same time, a patch is automatically enabled that fixes the shop map patch to work with both mods. This patch was sent to me by Scarlett - https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/75682593. Huge thanks!

[/size][size=4][b]Other News[/b][/size]
The 1.0.3 update also adds some flavor text to the interior of Leela's house and makes her sell all seeds in any season after giving the missing stocklist to Pierre.

[size=4][b]General[/b][/size]
Do you ever get tired of Pierre selling your crops as his own and bragging about it? Personally, I don't think he is a much better option than Joja. To solve this issue, I have created this content pack, which adds a little shop by the bus stop where you can buy and sell the same items as at Pierre's. This shop is run by Leela, who is a lovely elderly woman with three cats. 

[b][size=3]The shop[/size][/b]
The shop is open from 8am to 6pm every day. It works the same as Pierre's. You can buy and sell items there, as well as purchase your backpack upgrades.

[b][size=3]Leela [/size][/b]
Leela is a social NPC with dialogue and gift tastes. However, she does not attend the town festivals (This may be an option in the future, but because of compatibility issues with other NPC mods, I have chosen to keep her social functions minimal for now). As of now, she has regular base dialogue, as well as complete dialogue changes at 4 and 8 hearts and a winter outfit.

Gift taste:
Loves: fruit tree fruits, fruit tree saplings, flowers
Likes: fruits, books
Dislikes: gold bar

(All other items are standard taste)

[size=4][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]This mod may not be entirely compatible with recolors and mods that drastically change the bus stop area. The shop replaces a cliff in the original bus stop, so there shouldn't be issues with items/entities placed on the map. I would advise to clear out the area in front of the cliff before adding the mod if you wish to include it in an existing save file. 

If you find any issues, please feel free to let me know.

[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
If requested/if I find the time and energy to do so, I may add:
- recolor options for the shop exterior
- more dialogue and social functions for Leela, such as heart events, attending festivals or custom movie theater reactions

[b][size=4]Installing (PC)[/size][/b]
To install this content pack, download the mod file and extract the .zip file to the 'Mods' folder in your Stardew Valley game folder.

If you have issues or questions about the mod, please feel free to leave a comment. If I don't respond, you can contact me on Discord (yuninocorn) as I don't check Nexus often. Thank you!

Enjoy!
